traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.desc: Krenko can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of his turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Krenko makes two attacks with his scimitar.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage..

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.desc: When a creature Krenko can see targets him with an attack, Krenko chooses another goblin within 5 feet of him. The two goblins swap places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target instead.

sb.name: Loading Rig
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The rig is incapacitated while in the area of an [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|antimagic field]]. If targeted by [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], the rig must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Unstable
traits.desc: If the rig takes damage, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated with a speed of 0 until a creature activates it with a successful DC 10 Intelligence (Arcana) check made as an action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The armor makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
